raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Closes #44931

### Motivation

With `--reasoning-parser gpt-oss`, SGLang returns gpt-oss's analysis channel
as `message.reasoning_content`. When a client replays that assistant
tool-call turn (assistant tool call → tool result → next request), the
chain-of-thought never reaches the prompt: the stock gpt-oss chat template
reads prior CoT only from the assistant message's `thinking` field, while
`reasoning_content` is passed to the template under a name it ignores.
Measured on the issue's repro: 268 prompt tokens instead of 291, and the
replayed prompt no longer extends the previous prompt plus output, so
prefix-cache reuse stops at the start of that assistant turn.

### Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/openai/serving_chat.py`
  - New module-level helper `_replay_gpt_oss_reasoning_content_as_thinking()`
    that copies an assistant message's `reasoning_content` into `thinking`
    (never overwriting an explicitly provided `thinking`).
  - Called in `_apply_jinja_template`'s generic Jinja branch only, gated on
    `self.reasoning_parser == "gpt-oss"` (per-model opt-in, so no other
    model's template behavior changes). Custom encoders (dsv4/dsv41/dsv32,
    kimi_k3, inkling) are untouched.
  - Edge case the template itself flags: an assistant tool-call turn with
    non-empty `content` plus `thinking` makes the template raise
    ("Cannot pass both content and thinking in an assistant message with
    tool calls!", surfaced as HTTP 400). Instead of erroring or silently
    dropping the CoT, the preamble is folded into the analysis channel
    (`thinking = reasoning_content + "\n" + content`, generation order)
    and `content` is cleared, so the template always renders.
- `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_chat.py`
  - `TestReplayGptOssReasoningContentAsThinking`: 6 unit tests covering the
    copy, the explicit-`thinking` guard, the preamble merge (string and
    parts-list content), non-assistant messages, and the no-op case.

### Tests

- Verified against the real stock `openai/gpt-oss-20b` chat template's
  message loop (transcribed verbatim; only `raise_exception` message
  strings shortened) rendered with Jinja2: without the fix the replayed
  CoT is dropped from the analysis channel (bug reproduced); with the fix
  it renders as `<|start|>assistant<|channel|>analysis<|message|>…<|end|>`
  before the tool call; the preamble edge case renders merged with no
  template error. 17/17 harness checks pass.
- The 6 new unit tests pass against the AST-extracted helper (full
  `test_serving_chat.py` needs torch/GPU, unavailable on this machine).
- `ruff check --select F401,F821,F823,UP037`, `ruff format --check`,
  `python -m py_compile`, and `git diff --check` all pass on both touched
  files; no added line exceeds 88 columns.
- Not verifiable here: an end-to-end run against a live gpt-oss server
  (no GPU on this machine). Requesting CI via the `run-ci` label.

detail.title: [Fix] openai: replay gpt-oss reasoning_content as thinking for tool-call turns

files.patch:
@@ -190,6 +190,45 @@ def normalize_assistant_tool_call_arguments(
                     raise
 
 
+def _replay_gpt_oss_reasoning_content_as_thinking(
+    messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
+) -> None:
+    """Copy replayed ``reasoning_content`` into ``thinking`` in-place (gpt-oss only).
+
+    The stock gpt-oss chat template reads prior chain-of-thought only from the
+    assistant message's ``thinking`` field and ignores ``reasoning_content``,
+    so a client that faithfully replays the ``reasoning_content`` it received
+    would silently lose the CoT on every tool-calling turn
+    (sgl-project/sglang#44931). An explicitly provided ``thinking`` field is
+    never overwritten.
+    """
+    for message in messages:
+        if message.get("role") != "assistant":
+            continue
+        reasoning_content = message.get("reasoning_content")
+        if not reasoning_content or message.get("thinking"):
+            continue
+        content = message.get("content")
+        if message.get("tool_calls") and content:
+            # The gpt-oss template raises on an assistant tool-call message
+            # that carries both content and thinking, so fold the preamble
+            # into the analysis channel (generation order: analysis, then
+            # commentary) instead of dropping the CoT or erroring out.
+            if isinstance(content, list):
+                content = " ".join(
+                    part.get("text", "")
+                    for part in content
+                    if isinstance(part, dict)
+                    and part.get("type") in ("text", "input_text")
+                )
+            message["thinking"] = (
+                f"{reasoning_content}\n{content}" if content else reasoning_content
+            )
+            message["content"] = ""
+        else:
+            message["thinking"] = reasoning_content
+
+
 def _extract_max_dynamic_patch(request: ChatCompletionRequest):
     img_vals = []
     vid_vals = []
@@ -1685,6 +1724,11 @@ def _apply_jinja_template(
         else:
             if self.template_manager.jinja_template_may_reorder_tool_results:
                 messages = self._canonicalize_tool_message_order(messages)
+            if self.reasoning_parser == "gpt-oss":
+                # The stock gpt-oss chat template reads prior chain-of-thought
+                # from the assistant message's `thinking` field and ignores
+                # `reasoning_content` (sgl-project/sglang#44931).
+                _replay_gpt_oss_reasoning_content_as_thinking(messages)
             for msg_dict in copy.deepcopy(messages):
                 if msg_dict.get("content") is None:
                     msg_dict["content"] = ""

@@ -36,6 +36,7 @@
 )
 from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_chat import (
     OpenAIServingChat,
+    _replay_gpt_oss_reasoning_content_as_thinking,
     normalize_tool_content,
 )
 from sglang.srt.environ import envs
@@ -5095,6 +5096,80 @@ def test_mixed_str_and_dict_parts(self):
         self.assertEqual(result, "plain rich")
 
 
+class TestReplayGptOssReasoningContentAsThinking(unittest.TestCase):
+    """Unit tests for _replay_gpt_oss_reasoning_content_as_thinking()."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _tool_call_message(**kwargs):
+        message = {
+            "role": "assistant",
+            "content": "",
+            "tool_calls": [
+                {
+                    "id": "call_1",
+                    "type": "function",
+                    "function": {"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {}},
+                }
+            ],
+        }
+        message.update(kwargs)
+        return message
+
+    def test_reasoning_content_copied_to_thinking(self):
+        messages = [self._tool_call_message(reasoning_content="the CoT")]
+        _replay_gpt_oss_reasoning_content_as_thinking(messages)
+        self.assertEqual(messages[0]["thinking"], "the CoT")
+        # The source field is kept; the gpt-oss template simply ignores it.
+        self.assertEqual(messages[0]["reasoning_content"], "the CoT")
+
+    def test_explicit_thinking_never_overwritten(self):
+        messages = [
+            self._tool_call_message(
+                thinking="client thinking", reasoning_content="the CoT"
+            )
+        ]
+        _replay_gpt_oss_reasoning_content_as_thinking(messages)
+        self.assertEqual(messages[0]["thinking"], "client thinking")
+
+    def test_tool_call_with_preamble_merged_not_dropped(self):
+        # The gpt-oss template raises when a tool-call turn carries both
+        # content and thinking; folding the preamble into the analysis
+        # channel keeps both without tripping that guard.
+        messages = [
+            self._tool_call_message(
+                content="Let me check.", reasoning_content="the CoT"
+            )
+        ]
+        _replay_gpt_oss_reasoning_content_as_thinking(messages)
+        self.assertEqual(messages[0]["thinking"], "the CoT\nLet me check.")
+        self.assertEqual(messages[0]["content"], "")
+
+    def test_parts_list_preamble_flattened(self):
+        messages = [
+            self._tool_call_message(
+                content=[{"type": "text", "text": "One moment."}],
+                reasoning_content="the CoT",
+            )
+        ]
+        _replay_gpt_oss_reasoning_content_as_thinking(messages)
+        self.assertEqual(messages[0]["thinking"], "the CoT\nOne moment.")
+        self.assertEqual(messages[0]["content"], "")
+
+    def test_non_assistant_messages_untouched(self):
+        messages = [
+            {"role": "user", "content": "hi", "reasoning_content": "the CoT"},
+            {"role": "tool", "content": "ok", "reasoning_content": "the CoT"},
+        ]
+        _replay_gpt_oss_reasoning_content_as_thinking(messages)
+        for message in messages:
+            self.assertNotIn("thinking", message)
+
+    def test_no_reasoning_content_noop(self):
+        messages = [self._tool_call_message()]
+        _replay_gpt_oss_reasoning_content_as_thinking(messages)
+        self.assertNotIn("thinking", messages[0])
+
+
 class InklingReasoningEffortTest(unittest.TestCase):
     """Inkling reasoning-effort mapping and validation."""
